**Section:** Saṁyuttanikāya (sn)  
**Collection:** Sutta  
**Title (Pali):** Yakkha Saṁyutta  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0301m.mul9.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0301m.mul9.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Textual comparison with the Chinese parallel SA2 326 has notably helped resolve the reading of the nun's name in SN 10.11 as Vīrā or Cīrā [Bingenheimer, Studies in Agama Literature].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- This file contains 12 suttas; 12 of them have known parallels. Full parallels by collection: SA2 (11), SĀ (11), Pali (1)
